title: Article 67 — Term of office of Vice-President

content.overview: Article 67 provides that the Vice-President shall hold office for a term of five years from the date on which he enters upon his office. He may resign by writing addressed to the President. He may be removed by a resolution of the Council of States passed by a majority of all the then members of the Council and agreed to by the House of the People; at least fourteen days’ notice of the intention to move the resolution is required. He continues until his successor enters upon office.
content.glance: VP term: 5 years. Resign to President. Removal: RS resolution (majority of all then members) agreed to by LS; 14 days’ notice. Continues until successor enters.
content.study:
Article 67:
(1) Term of five years from entering upon office.
(2) Resignation by writing to the President.
(3) Removal by resolution of the Council of States passed by a majority of all the then members of the Council and agreed to by the House of the People; not less than fourteen days’ notice of the intention to move the resolution is required.
(4) Continues to hold office until successor enters upon office.

Examination: 5-year term; resign to President (not VP); removal requires both Houses (RS initiates with special majority of all then members; LS agrees); 14-day notice.

sections.heading: Term and removal
sections.body:
1. Term: five years.
2. Resignation: writing to the President.
3. Removal: RS resolution by majority of all then members + agreement of LS; ≥14 days’ notice.
4. Holdover until successor enters office.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How may the Vice-President be removed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 67, the Vice-President may be removed from office by a resolution of the Council of States passed by a majority of all the then members of the Council and agreed to by the House of the People. Not less than fourteen days’ notice of the intention to move the resolution is required.

examTips: 5 years; resign to President; RS majority of all then members + LS agreement; 14 days’ notice.

keyTakeaways: Art 67: VP term 5 years; removal by RS + LS.
